text: Top-of-funnel packaging uses the overlap between the ideal client and a wider dream follower.
An I made it asset documents an achieved desired outcome recognizable to both audiences.
Title, visual, and verbal hooks are designed as one opening.
A proven format is differentiated using evidence about why clients chose the creator.
Repeated why questions uncover deeper favorite-client resonance.
Middle-funnel ideas are checked for belief change, broad-enough hook, and clear message.
The demonstrated script progressively removes the wider audience while retaining the ideal client.
Familiar media packaging is used to carry niche education.
